core_pattern: They feel weight loss is harder because PCOD/PCOS makes cravings, irregular routines, slow progress, and frustration feel more common.
common_indian_moments: Trying multiple diets after seeing weight go up, avoiding sweets but still craving them, family comments about weight, doctor telling them to lose weight, feeling stuck despite "doing everything."
failed_attempts: Strict dieting, skipping meals, cutting sugar suddenly, gym starts, random weight-loss drinks, calorie tracking.
why_it_failed: The plan feels too hard to follow consistently, especially when cravings and slow progress make motivation drop.
relevant_ok_kit_role: OK Liquid helps reduce hunger and cravings, making it easier to stay with the plan. The 15-day routine, tracker, and coach support give structure without separate meal prep.
guardrail: Do not claim OK Kit treats PCOD, balances hormones, improves fertility, fixes insulin resistance, or cures PCOS.

core_pattern: When they feel stressed, tired, irritated, or mentally drained, they reach for food even when they are not truly hungry.
common_indian_moments: Work pressure, family stress, afternoon slump, late-night scrolling, argument at home, feeling low, ordering snacks after a bad day.
failed_attempts: Diet charts, calorie tracking, removing snacks from home, deciding to control from tomorrow.
why_it_failed: The trigger is not only hunger. Food becomes quick relief in the moment.
relevant_ok_kit_role: Stress will still happen. OK Liquid helps reduce hunger and cravings, so the customer has fewer food urges to fight during stressful moments. The tracker and coach support help them notice eating patterns and stay with the plan.
guardrail: Do not claim OK Kit cures stress, anxiety, depression, binge eating, or emotional eating disorders.

core_pattern: They want weight loss, but their day is packed and they do not want another complicated routine.
common_indian_moments: Back-to-back calls, office commute, late lunch, eating whatever is available, ordering dinner, skipping gym due to work.
failed_attempts: Gym memberships, meal prep plans, calorie tracking, strict diet charts.
why_it_failed: The plan needed too much time, planning, and mental bandwidth.
relevant_ok_kit_role: OK Kit gives a simple 15-day routine that works with regular homemade food and does not need separate meal prep or heavy workouts.
guardrail: Do not claim zero effort or no discipline needed.

core_pattern: They control food during the day but lose control at night.
common_indian_moments: Late-night scrolling, post-dinner cravings, ordering snacks, leftover sweets at home, watching TV after dinner.
failed_attempts: Skipping dinner, locking snacks away, drinking water, deciding not to eat after 8 pm.
why_it_failed: Night cravings feel stronger when they are tired, bored, or underfed.
relevant_ok_kit_role: OK Liquid helps reduce hunger and cravings during the day, while the course routine makes eating patterns more structured.
guardrail: Do not claim it stops all cravings permanently.

core_pattern: Their main weight-loss problem is not big meals. It is repeated small snacks through the day.
common_indian_moments: Tea-time biscuits, namkeen at desk, birthday cake at office, samosa with chai, pantry snacks, colleagues ordering food.
failed_attempts: Carrying healthy snacks, saying no to office food, skipping lunch, trying to avoid pantry visits.
why_it_failed: The environment keeps triggering small eating moments.
relevant_ok_kit_role: OK Liquid helps reduce hunger and cravings, making it easier to avoid unnecessary snacking between meals.
guardrail: Do not shame snacking or call the person lazy.

core_pattern: They spend the day around food and family meals, so small extra bites add up.
common_indian_moments: Tasting while cooking, finishing children's leftovers, tea snacks, guests bringing sweets, family meal pressure.
failed_attempts: Skipping meals, eating separately, trying boiled food, cutting rice or roti completely.
why_it_failed: The home environment keeps them close to food all day.
relevant_ok_kit_role: OK Kit works with regular homemade food and helps reduce hunger and cravings, making the routine easier to follow at home.
guardrail: Do not imply homemakers lack discipline.

core_pattern: They have tried many plans and now doubt whether they can stick to anything.
common_indian_moments: Starting every Monday, stopping after 3 days, trying keto, fasting, detox drinks, YouTube diet plans.
failed_attempts: Strict diet charts, intermittent fasting, gym plans, random Ayurvedic products.
why_it_failed: The plans were too hard, too confusing, or too dependent on willpower.
relevant_ok_kit_role: OK Kit gives a clear 15-day course with appetite support, food guidance, tracker, and coach support.

core_pattern: Sweet cravings repeatedly break their weight-loss plan.
common_indian_moments: Tea with biscuits, mithai at home, after-meal sweet craving, office birthdays, festivals, dessert after dinner.
failed_attempts: Quitting sugar suddenly, replacing sweets, avoiding sweets at home.

relevant_ok_kit_role: OK Liquid helps reduce hunger and cravings, making it easier to stay with the plan.

core_pattern: They want weight loss but cannot or do not want to do heavy workouts.
common_indian_moments: No time for gym, knee pain, low stamina, household responsibilities, office fatigue.
failed_attempts: Joining gym, walking for a few days, YouTube workouts.

relevant_ok_kit_role: OK Kit supports weight loss through appetite control and food routine. Walking or yoga can support results, but heavy workouts are not required.
guardrail: Do not say no movement or no effort is needed.

core_pattern: They want to lose post-pregnancy weight but struggle with routine, energy, and family responsibilities.
common_indian_moments: Irregular sleep, baby care, family meals, lack of personal time, clothes not fitting.
failed_attempts: Skipping meals, home workouts, random diets.
why_it_failed: Life feels too unpredictable for a strict plan.
relevant_ok_kit_role: OK Kit gives a structured 15-day course with simple food guidance and support.
guardrail: Do not target pregnant women or women within 6 months postpartum. Do not discuss breastfeeding safety unless cleared by doctor.
